This is a structural shift for every executive team running an AI strategy. The cost and complexity of connecting AI to each business tool has been one of the biggest adoption barriers. Astra compresses that work dramatically. One model that can navigate your CRM, your analytics dashboards, your project management suite, and your internal tools.
